newsitem.title: UK: Sugar freight - Tonnage sought for Brazil cargoes.
newsitem.headline: Sugar freight - Tonnage sought for Brazil cargoes.

text.p: The main feature among the few new orders circulating the sugar freight market was tonnage being sought to move brazilian stems, brokers said.
New business - Mauritius Sugar 18,000 bulk Port Louis to London early Aug.
Glencore 22,000/25,000 bulk Santos to Baltic, Black Sea or Egyptian Med, end July.
Cargill 14,000 bulk Paranagua or Santos to Baltic, Black Sea of Egyptian Med end July.
Simab 13,000/14,000 bagged Brazil to Sri Lanka or BangladesH July/August.
Fixtures - CSR 20,000 bulk Queensland to Ho Chi Minh City July 31/Aug 9.
Czarnikow -Rionda 14,000 bagged Paranagua to Red Sea or East Africa prompt.
